title: onboard-orbit-13b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Sofia Patel
description:
Onboard Orbit-13B v1.0: add model metadata, performance profiles, and wire up changelog/release-notes automation.

Motivation: Orbit-13B is a community model with strong accuracy for multi-turn chat use-cases and competitive throughput after 4-bit quantization variants. This PR adds the curated metadata (weights reference, tokenization notes, recommended quantization profiles), per-hardware performance profiles generated from our perf harness, and a small automation step so the model registry generates a changelog entry when the model is published.

What this PR does (high level):
- Add models/orbit/13b/v1.0/model_metadata.yaml with provenance, license, and tokenizer notes.
- Add models/orbit/13b/v1.0/perf_profiles.json with measurements collected from perf-canary on A100-40GB, T4-16GB, and CPU fallback traces. Profiles include p50/p95 latency and throughput for 1- and 8-token continuous generation scenarios, and quantized variants (int8/ggml-q4_0).
- Add a changelog fragment template and update the registry index to reference the new model.
- Add GH Actions workflow (registry-changelog-generator.yml) tweak to include model metadata tags in generated release notes. The automation respects draft publish flags and includes a short perf-summary row in the generated changelog.

Checklist: [x] model metadata added and validated, [x] perf profiles added and verified against harness, [x] changelog automation picks up meta and perf-summary, [x] docs example updated in registry README, [x] tests (schema + perf parsing) pass locally and in CI.

Notes on verification: perf profiles were generated using the perf-harness job id perf-2026-02-15-089 and were validated with the metrics-qa script to ensure no missing fields. Quantization recommendations were suggested by the Optimize team: prefer int8-fp16 mixed pipeline for A100, int8 static for T4 for best latency/throughput balance.

Related: ENG-4621 (model onboarding), PM-3140 (product request), ref: existing onboarding PRs for Arcus/Orion for structure and automation examples.

Release notes: this PR adds Orbit-13B v1.0 to the model catalog with performance guidance and automated changelog entry generation.
